subject: Movement and Coordination
en:
Adult: I want to see how many different ways you can move down this (pointing) incline.
Adult: Good—you can roll sideways down the incline. What’s another way? Child crawls down incline
Adult: Right—you can crawl down the incline on your hands and knees, etc.
zh:
成人：我想看看你能想出多少种不同的办法，从这个斜坡上（指着斜坡）下来。
成人：很好——你可以侧身从斜坡上滚下来。还有什么别的办法？（儿童爬下斜坡）
成人：对——你可以用手和膝盖爬下斜坡，等等。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
en:
Child: I made a picture.
Adult: Let’s see. What can you tell me about your picture?
Child: It’s me.
Adult: Ahh, you drew a picture of yourself. Can you tell me about the different parts of the drawing—the different parts of the body; what is this (points to head)?
Child: The head.
Adult: You drew a picture of a head. And where is your head? Point to your head. That’s right. Now tell me about the different parts of the head you drew. Where are the eyebrows? Are these the eyebrows?
zh:
儿童：我画了一幅画。
成人：让我看看。你能跟我说说你的画吗？
儿童：这是我。
成人：啊，你画了一幅你自己。你能跟我说说画里的不同部分吗——身体的不同部位；这是什么（指着头部）？
儿童：头。
成人：你画了一个头。那你的头在哪里？指一指你的头。对了。现在跟我说说你画的头的各个部分。眉毛在哪里？这些是眉毛吗？

subject: Social and Emotional Development
topic: Social and Emotional Development: Work Habits
en:
Child: Uh oh! The milk spilled. It’s a big mess.
Adult: Oops, there was an accident and the milk spilled. That’s okay—sometimes accidents happen. Sometimes we make mistakes—everyone does. But now there is a mess. Let’s see—what do we need to do with the mess? What do we need to do to fix or correct what happened?
Child: Clean it up.
Adult: That’s right. And when we make a mess or spill something, it’s our responsibility to clean it up—that means that it’s our job to clean it up. I’ll help you by getting the sponge for you and then you can be responsible for wiping up the milk (hands child the sponge). Do you know how to wipe up the milk or should I show you how to get started?
zh:
儿童：哎呀！牛奶洒了。弄得一团糟。
成人：哎呀，不小心把牛奶洒了。没关系——有时候会发生意外。有时候我们会犯错——每个人都会。但现在弄脏了。让我想想——我们需要怎么处理这团糟？我们要怎么做才能弥补或纠正发生的事？
儿童：把它清理干净。
成人：对了。当我们弄脏或洒了东西时，把它清理干净是我们的责任——也就是说，清理干净是我们的分内之事。我来帮你拿海绵，然后由你负责把牛奶擦干净（把海绵递给儿童）。你知道怎么擦牛奶吗，还是我示范给你看怎么开始？

subject: Language and Literacy
en:
Adult: Here are some pictures of different things. See—here’s a picture of an apple, an ice cream cone, a dress, a cookie, a pair of shoes, a jacket, a pair of pants and a hamburger. Some of these pictures “go together.” They belong to the same group of things; they belong to the same category. See—I can put the apple, the ice cream cone and the cookie all together in a group: they are all things that we can eat; they belong to the food category. Do you see another picture that belongs to the food category?
Child: (points to picture of the hamburger)
Adult: That’s right—we can eat an apple, an ice cream cone, a cookie or a ...? (points to picture of hamburger and pauses expectantly)
Child: Hamburger.
Adult: (nods) ...So they all belong to the food category. Here are some other pictures that belong to another group or category.
zh:
成人：这里有一些不同东西的图片。看——这是一张苹果的图片，一个冰淇淋蛋筒、一条裙子、一块饼干、一双鞋、一件夹克、一条裤子和一个汉堡包。有些图片是“归为一类”的。它们属于同一组东西；属于同一类别。看——我可以把苹果、冰淇淋蛋筒和饼干放在一起组成一组：它们都是我们可以吃的东西；属于食物类别。你看到另一张属于食物类别的图片了吗？
儿童：（指着汉堡包的图片）
成人：对了——我们可以吃苹果、冰淇淋蛋筒、饼干或者……？（指着汉堡包的图片，期待地停顿）
儿童：汉堡包。
成人：（点头）……所以它们都属于食物类别。这里还有一些属于另一组或另一类别的图片。

subject: Language and Literacy
topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
en:
Adult: Listen to this nursery rhyme while I recite it—it has rhyming words: To market, to market, to buy a fat pig (emphasis on pig) Home again, home again, jiggety-jig. (emphasis on jig). Pig and jig are rhyming words. Try to say or echo the rhyming words with me: To market, to market, to buy a fat (pause—child and adult together): p…ig Home again, home again, jiggety (pause—child and adult together): j…ig. Did you hear the two rhyming words? pig and …
Child: jig.
Adult: That’s right—pig and jig are rhyming words. Now listen while I recite another verse—there are some other rhyming words: To market, to market, to buy a fat hog (emphasis on hog) Home again, home again, jiggety-jog. (emphasis on jog), etc.
zh:
成人：听我念这首童谣——里面有押韵的词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥猪（重读 pig），回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个不停（重读 jig）。pig 和 jig 是押韵词。试着跟我一起说、跟着念这些押韵词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥（停顿——儿童和成人一起）p…ig；回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个（停顿——儿童和成人一起）j…ig。你听到那两个押韵的词了吗？pig 和……
儿童：jig。
成人：对了——pig 和 jig 是押韵词。现在听我念另一段——里面还有别的押韵词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥猪（重读 hog），回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个不停（重读 jog），等等。

subject: Language and Literacy
en:
Adult: Do you remember that yesterday we read the story, The Red Balloon? Today, we are going to look at the illustrations in The Red Balloon, the pictures. I want you to retell the story of The Red Balloon. We’ll look at each illustration in order and you’ll tell me what was happening in the story. Here’s the first illustration—tell me about the characters—who you see in the picture—and what was happening.
Child: This is Pascal and, etc.
zh:
成人：还记得我们昨天读的故事《红气球》吗？今天，我们要看《红气球》里的插图，也就是图画。我想让你复述《红气球》的故事。我们会按顺序看每一幅插图，你告诉我故事里发生了什么。这是第一幅插图——跟我说说里面的角色——你在图中看到谁——以及发生了什么。
儿童：这是帕斯卡尔，等等。

subject: Language and Literacy
topic: Emerging Literacy Skills in Reading and Writing
en:
Adult: I’m going to draw some points. Here are two points. I want you to connect these points with a straight line. Can you start at this point and, with your finger, show me how you would connect these points using a straight line?
Child: (traces line)
Adult: Good. You made a straight line with your finger. Here’s a piece of string. I’m going to hold one end of the string on one point. Can you use the rest of the string to make a straight line to connect the two points?
zh:
成人：我要画几个点。这里有两个点。我想让你用一条直线把这两个点连起来。你能从这个点开始，用手指给我演示怎么画一条直线把两点连起来吗？
儿童：（沿着线描画）
成人：很好。你用手指画了一条直线。这里有根绳子。我要把绳子的一头按在一个点上。你能用剩下的绳子拉成一条直线，把两个点连起来吗？

subject: Mathematics
en:
Child: Look—I made two piles.
Adult: Let’s see what you did. Ah, you sorted the beads into two different piles or groups. (Pointing) Is this group the same or different than this group?
Child: (no response)
Adult: (Pointing) This group is d... Classification different same
zh:
儿童：看——我分成了两堆。
成人：让我看看你做了什么。啊，你把珠子分成了不同的两堆，也就是两组。（指着）这一组和那一组是相同的还是不同的？
儿童：（没有回应）
成人：（指着）这一组是 d……（分类：不同、相同）

subject: Mathematics
en:
Adult: This group is different from this group. Can you tell me how they are different?
Child: This has red things and this has blue things.
Adult: Right—this group has red beads and this group has blue beads. You sorted the beads into two different groups according to their color. If I give you these other beads (pile of yellow and green beads), can you also sort them into two different groups according to their color?
zh:
成人：这一组和那一组不一样。你能告诉我它们怎么不一样吗？
儿童：这一堆是红色的东西，那一堆是蓝色的东西。
成人：对——这一组是红珠子，那一组是蓝珠子。你按颜色把珠子分成了两组。如果我再给你这些珠子（一堆黄色和绿色的珠子），你也能按颜色把它们分成两组吗？

subject: History and Geography
topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Time
en:
Child: (showing photos brought from home) This is me when I was little.
Adult: Let’s look at them together. Can you tell me about each of these pictures that were taken when you were a baby?
Child: This is me in my crib. I’m drinking a bottle. This is me too.
Adult: What were you doing in that picture?
Child: Don’t know.
Adult: It looks like you were crawling on the floor.
Child: Yeah—crawling. And this is me—outside.
Adult: Ahh, you were going for a ride in the stroller. Who is this adult? Who is pushing the stroller?
Child: Mommy.
Adult: So when you were a baby, Mommy took you for a ride in the stroller? I’m glad you have these pictures of things that you did when you were a baby. They’re things that already happened—they’re things you did in the past. It’s fun to remember things you did in the past. Can you remember any other things you did in the past when you were a baby?
Child: No.
Adult: Here are some drawings of babies doing different things. Maybe, they’ll help you remember something you did in the past when you were a baby (pointing). How about this?
Child: Diapers.
Adult: When you were a baby, you wore diapers. That was something you did in the past. You don’t wear diapers now!
zh:
儿童：（展示从家里带来的照片）这是我小时候。
成人：我们一起看看吧。你能跟我说说这些你还是小宝宝时拍的照片吗？每一张都讲讲。
儿童：这是我在婴儿床里。我在喝奶瓶。这也是我。
成人：那张照片里你在做什么？
儿童：不知道。
成人：看起来你当时在地板上爬。
儿童：对——在爬。这是我在——外面。
成人：啊，你当时坐着婴儿车出去玩。这位大人是谁？谁在推婴儿车？
儿童：妈妈。
成人：所以你还是小宝宝的时候，妈妈推着婴儿车带你出去玩？我很高兴你有这些你小时候做过的事情的照片。这些都是已经发生过的事——是你过去做的事。回忆过去做过的事很有趣。你还记得小时候过去做过的其他事情吗？
儿童：不记得。
成人：这里有一些画着宝宝做各种事情的图。也许它们能帮你想起你小时候过去做过的某件事（指着）。这个怎么样？
儿童：尿布。
成人：你小时候穿尿布。那是你过去的事。现在你不穿尿布啦！

subject: History and Geography
topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Space
en:
Child: Look what I made.
Adult: What did you make?
Child: I colored.
Adult: Yes, you made a very pretty design on the graph paper. In your design, did you use the same color or a different color for each little box?
Child: Different colors.
Adult: Your design is very colorful because you used a lot of different colors—each box is different. Danny made a design on graph paper today, too. Maybe tomorrow you can exchange designs—you can see if you can copy Danny’s design and he can try to copy your design.
zh:
儿童：看我做的。
成人：你做了什么？
儿童：我涂了颜色。
成人：是啊，你在方格纸上做了一个非常漂亮的图案。在你的图案里，每个小格子用的是相同的颜色还是不同的颜色？
儿童：不同的颜色。
成人：你的图案五颜六色，因为你用了很多不同的颜色——每个格子都不一样。丹尼今天也在方格纸上做了一个图案。也许明天你们可以交换图案——看看你能不能照着画丹尼的图案，他也试着照着画你的图案。

subject: Science
topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
en:
Child: Oh, look—there are green things coming out of the dirt!
Adult: Ahh, you’re right! I see a little green stem. Look carefully—what do these two little things on the top of the stem look like?
Child: Other parts.
Adult: Yes, each one is a little leaf. Can you gently point to the leaf on each side of the stem?
Child: Here and here?
Adult: That’s right, those are the leaves. Now, where do you suppose the stem came from? How did it get here in the soil?
Child: (silence)
zh:
儿童：哦，看——有绿色的东西从土里冒出来了！
成人：啊，你说得对！我看到一根绿色的小茎。仔细看——茎顶上这两个小东西像什么？
儿童：是别的部分。
成人：是的，每一个都是一片小叶子。你能轻轻指着茎两边的叶子吗？
儿童：这里和这里？
成人：对了，那些就是叶子。那么，你觉得这根茎是从哪里来的？它是怎么长到土里来的？
儿童：（沉默）

subject: Science
topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
en:
Child: A seed.
Adult: That’s right. Look at the drawings you’ve made so far to record your observations. See, in the first picture, you drew a picture of the seed in the soil. Tell me about this next picture. What did you draw?
Child: It’s the seed in the dirt. I’m giving it some water.
Adult: (pointing) What else is the seed getting in your picture?
Child: The sun.
Adult: Right. The sun and water made this green stem grow from the seed. Do you think it would be a good idea to draw another picture of your observations today?
zh:
儿童：一颗种子。
成人：对。看看你到目前为止为了记录观察而画的画。看，第一幅画里，你画的是土里的种子。跟我说说下一幅画。你画了什么？
儿童：是土里的种子。我在给它浇水。
成人：（指着）在你的画里，种子还得到了什么？
儿童：阳光。
成人：对。阳光和水让这根绿色的茎从种子里长了出来。你觉得今天再画一幅你观察的画是个好主意吗？

subject: Music
en:
Adult: Listen—I’m going to clap my hands—I’m going to make a clapping pattern. Listen carefully. When I finish, I’m going to ask you to try to copy it. (clap pattern)
Adult: Okay, I’m going to repeat the clapping pattern, but this time, you try to do it with me. (adult and child clap together)
Adult: Now I’m going to make a new clapping pattern. Listen carefully. When I finish, I will ask you to repeat it by yourself.
zh:
成人：听——我要拍手——我要拍出一个拍手节奏。仔细听。我拍完后，会请你试着跟着拍出来。（拍手节奏）
成人：好，我再把拍手节奏拍一遍，不过这次，你试着和我一起拍。（成人和儿童一起拍手）
成人：现在我要拍一个新的拍手节奏。仔细听。我拍完后，会请你自己重复一遍。

subject: Visual Arts
en:
Adult: This is a picture of a sculpture that was created by the artist Edgar Degas. Can you tell me about this sculpture? What do you see?
Child: It’s a person.
Adult: Uh huh, it’s a sculpture of a person. What kind of person? Is it a man or woman? Or is it a girl or boy?
Child: It looks like a girl ‘cause she has a pony tail.
Adult: So it’s a sculpture of a girl. How is she dressed? Is she wearing regular clothes?
Child: No—she looks like she’s wearing a funny short skirt
Adult: Yes, she is. She’s wearing a special costume that’s used for dancing, etc.
zh:
成人：这是一张艺术家埃德加·德加创作的雕塑的图片。你能跟我说说这座雕塑吗？你看到了什么？
儿童：是一个人。
成人：嗯，是一座人物的雕塑。是什么样的人？是男人还是女人？还是女孩或男孩？
儿童：看起来像个女孩，因为她扎着马尾辫。
成人：所以是一座女孩的雕塑。她穿着什么？穿的是普通衣服吗？
儿童：不是——她看起来穿着一条滑稽的短裙。
成人：是的。她穿着一种专门用来跳舞的特殊服装，等等。

subject: History and Geography
en: As you introduce students to early civilizations, keep in mind the question, What is civilization?
zh: 什么是文明？

subject: Mathematics
en: Example questions: how many in each category, or how many more or less are in one category than in another.
zh: 示例问题：每一类有多少，或某一类比另一类多多少、少多少。
details: Describe shares using the words halves, fourths, and quarters. | Use the phrases half of, fourth of, and quarter of. | Describe the whole as two of, or four of the shares. | Understand for these examples that decomposing into more equal shares creates smaller shares. Use concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/ or the relationship between addition and subtraction

subject: History and Geography
en: Through analogies to familiar settings—the family, the school, the community—discuss some basic questions regarding American government, such as: ”What is government?“ ”What are some basic functions of American government?“ (Making and enforcing laws; settling disputes; protecting rights and liberties, etc.) Only basic questions need to be addressed at this grade level.
zh: 通过类比学生熟悉的环境——家庭、学校、社区——讨论有关美国政府的一些基本问题，例如：“什么是政府？”“美国政府有哪些基本职能？”（制定和执行法律；解决争端；保护权利与自由等）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Discuss with students: What is an immigrant?
zh: 与学生讨论：什么是移民？

subject: History and Geography
en: Why do people leave their home countries to make a new home in America?
zh: 为什么人们离开祖国到美国建立新家？

subject: History and Geography
en: What is it like to be a newcomer in America?
zh: 在美国做新移民是什么感觉？

subject: History and Geography
en: What hardships have immigrants faced?
zh: 移民面临过哪些艰难困苦？

subject: History and Geography
en: What opportunities have they found?
zh: 他们找到了哪些机会？

subject: History and Geography
en: Discuss with students basic questions and issues about government, such as: Why do societies need government?
zh: 与学生讨论有关政府的基本问题，例如：社会为什么需要政府？

subject: History and Geography
en: Why does a society need laws?
zh: 社会为什么需要法律？

subject: History and Geography
en: Who makes the laws in the United States?
zh: 美国由谁制定法律？

subject: History and Geography
en: What might happen in the absence of government and laws?
zh: 如果没有政府和法律，可能会发生什么？

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a comma to set off the words yes and no (e.g., Yes, I would like a glass of water.), to set off a tag question from the rest of the sentence (e.g., That can’t possibly be true, could it?), and to indicate direct address (e.g., What are your thoughts on the matter, Derek?).
zh: 用逗号把 yes 和 no 隔开（例如：Yes, I would like a glass of water.），用逗号把附加问句与句子其余部分隔开（例如：That can't possibly be true, could it?），并用逗号表示直接称呼（例如：What are your thoughts on the matter, Derek?）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Discuss with students: How do we know about these ancient civilizations? (Through archaeological findings; ancient artifacts and writings; writings by European missionaries and conquerors, etc.).
zh: 与学生讨论：我们如何得知这些古代文明的情况？（通过考古发现；古代文物与文字记载；欧洲传教士和征服者的著述等。）

subject: English Language Arts
en: “Is It a Crime for a U.S. Citizen to Vote?”—Speech by Susan B. Anthony (1873)
zh: 《美国公民投票是犯罪吗？》——苏珊·B·安东尼演说（1873）
work: Is It a Crime for a U.S. Citizen to Vote
work_en: Is It a Crime for a U.S. Citizen to Vote

subject: History and Geography
en: What is a desert? Hot and cold deserts, oasis
zh: 什么是沙漠？热沙漠与冷沙漠，绿洲

subject: History and Geography
en: John W. Burgess, What is Real Political Progress?, absolutism
zh: 约翰·W·伯吉斯，《什么是真正的政治进步？》，专制主义
work: 什么是真正的政治进步？
